card.name: Encouraging beginners to try or learn
card.fires_on: Words in promotional or encouraging text that invite newcomers to learn or join something, such as 'considered participating', 'learn how easy it is', or 'scared away from'. It marks the point where the text reassures that a topic is easy, fun or approachable.
